python-sounddevice on Omarchy

Python bindings for PortAudio to record and play back sound as NumPy arrays.

Package data synced 2026-10-17 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install python-sounddevice on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add python-sounddevice. It is a 77 KB download (389.9 KB installed), version 0.5.6-1, licensed MIT. Record and play back sound. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install python-sounddevice on Omarchy

python-sounddevice is a small Python library wrapping PortAudio, letting you play and record audio using NumPy arrays. It's aimed at developers, researchers and musicians who want simple, cross-platform programmatic control over audio input and output from Python, fitting naturally into existing NumPy-based signal-processing code.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add python-sounddevice
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.5.6-1:
    pacman -Qi python-sounddevice

Open and use python-sounddevice

python-sounddevice has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql python-sounddevice | grep /usr/bin/

python-sounddevice requirements and compatibility

  • The PortAudio library installed on the system
  • A working audio input/output device to actually record or play sound

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • portaudio
  • python-cffi

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: MIT.

Uninstall python-sounddevice

omarchy pkg drop python-sounddevice

Frequently asked questions

How do I install python-sounddevice on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add python-sounddevice. The download is 77 KB and it takes 389.9 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is python-sounddevice free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall python-sounddevice?

Run omarchy pkg drop python-sounddevice. It removes the package from your system.

What does python-sounddevice depend on?

The package declares 2 dependencies: portaudio, python-cffi. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is python-sounddevice a desktop app?

No. python-sounddevice has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is python-sounddevice in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as python-sounddevice (version 0.5.6-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Matthias Geier makes it. Project site: https://python-sounddevice.rtfd.io/. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
